closing: Without tafsīr, it is only words.

captions.en: The wisdom of why the Qur'ān was sent down is for you to contemplate it.
That is the wisdom behind why it was sent down.
If you are not pondering the Qur'ān, that wisdom is lost.

captions.ar: وَصَارَ مُجَرَّدَ أَلْفَاظٍ لَا تَأْثِيرَ لَهَا
captions.en: And it became merely words with no effect.
It just becomes words that have no effect.
